note: Written before any return was computed (before the shift-selection step and before the IC/basket step).
data: OAP Predictors.parquet columns permno, yyyymm, AnnouncementReturn only; rows yyyymm>201412 dropped at read time. Panel: adj and member only; tickers never read (column index is the join key).
announcement_month: For each permno, rows sorted by yyyymm: month m is an announcement (raw OAP time) iff AR[m] is non-null and differs (exact float compare) from the last earlier non-null AR of that permno; if no earlier non-null AR exists, m counts only if the permno has an earlier OAP row (seen changing from null), so a stale value at the first row is not counted.
link: link_permno_col.csv used as-is (corr>=.98, mad<.005 already applied there). Because a panel column can map to several permnos over time and the link has no dates, a (column, month t) pair is linked only if exactly one of the column's linked permnos has an OAP row at yyyymm=t; if 0 or >=2 do, the pair is unlinked that month. If one permno is linked to two columns that are both members at t, both are dropped that month. Unlinked members are left out of the IC cross-section.
shift_selection: Only 2008-01..2014-12 raw announcement months A of linked members (member at end of month A-2, i.e. at the start of month A-1). Monthly market-adjusted return mar(k) = stock month-end to month-end return minus the equal-weighted mean of that month's return over members at the end of month k-1. Event votes shift 0 if |mar(A)| > |mar(A-1)|, else shift -1 (both must be finite). The shift with more votes is fixed for the whole test (ties -> 0). Counted as 1 trial in the pre-registered N.
shift_application: shift s in {0,-1}: true announcement indicator I'[m] = I[m - s] (s=-1 means the OAP change month is one month after the real announcement month, so I'[m] = I[m+1]). With s=-1 the condition 'no announcement in month t' reads the OAP row of month t+1 (<=201412), which reflects an announcement made in month t and so known at end of month t (aside from a day-+1 return spilling into t+1).
signal: At month-end t, signal=1 iff I'[t-11]=1 and I'[t]=0 and sum I'[t-11..t] == 4 (exactly 4); else 0 (including permnos with no announcement history).
universe: Members at the last trading day of month t, linked per the rule above, with finite adj at the entry day.
forward_return: Entry at close of the 2nd trading day after month-end t (trading-day index of month-end t + 2); exit at the last trading day of month t+1. If adj is missing at exit (delisted in the month), the last finite adj after entry and on or before exit is used (delisting returns unknown). If none, the stock is dropped.
ic: Monthly Spearman = Pearson correlation of average ranks (ties averaged) between the binary signal and forward return. A month is skipped when the cross-section has no signal variation or fewer than 20 stocks; skipped months are reported.
periods: Months are labeled by holding month t+1. Full sample holding months 1975-01..2014-12 (decision months 1974-12..2014-11). Decades 1975-84, 1985-94, 1995-04, 2005-14 and 1989-2014 by holding month.
t_stat: Plain t = mean/(sd/sqrt(n)) of monthly ICs (reported, not part of the gate).
gate: KEEP only if mean IC 1975-2014 >= 0.05 AND each of the four decade means > 0 AND the 1989-2014 mean > 0; otherwise CLOSE.
secondary_basket: Reference only: equal-weight basket of signal=1 stocks vs equal-weight of all members at t with a valid forward return over the same entry-exit window (benchmark not restricted to linked). Basket cost: 10bp one way at entry and 10bp at exit = 20bp per month (the basket is fully exited each month-end). Months with an empty basket are dropped and counted.
coverage: Per decision month: members, linked members; split by whether the column's last finite adj date is before 2014-12-31 (later-delisted) or not (other).
